iconography.realia_identification: Male head in profile with crested/feathered headdress or helmet
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Plumed Head.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/a₂/', '/ku/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 02 (Plumed Head) depicts Male head in profile with crested/feathered headdress or helmet. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_040 and Linear A unattested. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/a₂/', '/ku/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 02): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Plumed Head) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/a₂/', '/ku/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
